behaviors.description: Port the original twenty-ray six-bounce listener batch and transmission/echo estimator through immutable current-scene geometry.
behaviors.selection: Authorized Mirror restoration; shared integration and native validation pending.

checks.expectation: Port the original twenty-ray six-bounce listener batch and transmission/echo estimator through immutable current-scene geometry.
checks.procedure: Rewrite owns validation: compare retained Cardinal formulas/scripts, run new unit checks, wire registered hooks into Mirror, verify native macOS and iOS output, source movement/removal, failure cleanup and callback underrun telemetry. Source presence and compilation alone are not audible verification.

checks.expectation: The twenty-ray work budget and live head/source response remain unchanged. Only identical visibility queries through the same immutable geometry revision may reuse results; endpoint/distance changes and geometry revisions invalidate reuse. Terrain invocation borrows the full accepted geometry under the same contract and Audicle attribution.
checks.procedure: Run audio::acoustic::tests including counting-query invalidation, existing reflection/transmission and moving-source checks; benchmark the real embedded game with audio enabled. Caching is off the audio callback.

checks.expectation: A closer accepted surface or venue hit bounds terrain traversal without changing the original sample spacing, crossing bracket, normal or closest-hit ordering; acoustic ray budgets remain unchanged.
checks.procedure: Run bounded_terrain_trace_matches_full_grid_near_venue_and_excavation against full-grid reference results, then real game and embedded audio benchmarks.

behaviors.description: Wind uses direct upper-hemisphere outdoor escape solid angle to lower and angle its omni emitter toward openings, eases over 0.35 seconds, and retains above-roof suppression with no openings. Player and microphone retain independent worker-side state.
behaviors.selection: Mirror environment session with outdoor wind enabled.

checks.expectation: Wind uses direct upper-hemisphere outdoor escape solid angle to lower and angle its omni emitter toward openings, eases over 0.35 seconds, and retains above-roof suppression with no openings. Player and microphone retain independent worker-side state.
checks.procedure: Run wind_cover_tests for open and shut doors, deep interior, local up, roofs, independent receivers and easing; listen while crossing real theatre doorways.
